name: gh-stack
title: GH Stack
summary: Create, maintain, and merge stacked pull requests with the gh stack CLI extension.

use_when: Creating, viewing, editing, pushing, submitting, syncing, rebasing, or merging a stack of dependent branches or PRs with gh stack
Splitting multi-part work into small reviewable branch layers
The user mentions a stack, branch layers, dependent PRs, or gh stack
A gh-stack stack is checked out in the current repository
avoid_when: General Git history, branching, or recovery planning without gh stack — use git-workflow
Reviewing PR content or findings — use pr-review
A live production incident — use incident-response
